newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian BACOB denies in talks with Austrian bank.
newsitem.headline: Belgian BACOB denies in talks with Austrian bank.

text.p: BACOB Bank, Belgium's seventh-largest bank, denied on Monday a report in an Austrian magazine that it was in cooperation talks with Austrian GiroCredit Bank.
"At this moment, there are no talks with GiroCredit. The conclusions drawn by the Austrian press are premature," BACOB spokesman Guido Mertens told Reuters.
BACOB chief executive Dirk Bruneel said last week that his bank is looking for a foreign partner in preparation for the advent of the single currency.
He said his bank was looking for a bank similar to BACOB in France, Germany, Austria or the Netherlands. BACOB is a former savings bank owned by Belgium's christian democratic workers' movement.
GiroCredit is Austria's third-biggest savings bank.
